Azure DevOps organization with its project list
Azure Repos Git repository plus default-branch policies
Business application registered through the UI or ingest API

controls.name: Organization requires 2FA
controls.description: All members of the GitHub organization must have two-factor authentication enabled.
controls.remediation: Organization settings → Authentication security → Require two-factor authentication.

controls.name: Base repository permission is read or none
controls.description: Members should not get write/admin on every repository by default.
controls.remediation: Organization settings → Member privileges → Base permissions → Read or No permission.

controls.name: Members cannot create public repositories
controls.description: Only owners should be able to make code public.
controls.remediation: Organization settings → Member privileges → Repository creation → untick Public.

controls.name: Default branch is protected
controls.description: The default branch is covered by a branch protection rule or an active ruleset.
controls.remediation: Add a branch protection rule or repository ruleset targeting the default branch.

controls.name: Pull requests require an approving review
controls.description: At least one approving review is required before merging into the default branch.
controls.remediation: Enable 'Require a pull request before merging' with at least 1 required approval.

controls.name: Force pushes to the default branch are blocked
controls.description: History on the default branch cannot be rewritten.
controls.remediation: Disable 'Allow force pushes' in branch protection, or add the 'Block force pushes' ruleset rule.

controls.name: Dependabot alerts are enabled
controls.description: Vulnerable dependencies are reported through Dependabot alerts.
controls.remediation: Repository settings → Code security → Dependabot alerts → Enable.

controls.name: Secret scanning is enabled
controls.description: GitHub secret scanning is turned on for the repository.
controls.remediation: Repository settings → Code security → Secret scanning → Enable.

controls.name: CODEOWNERS file is present
controls.description: A CODEOWNERS file assigns reviewers for every change.
controls.remediation: Add CODEOWNERS at the repository root, .github/ or docs/.

controls.name: Repository is not public without approval
controls.description: Public repositories must carry the 'public-approved' topic.
controls.remediation: Make the repository private/internal, or add the 'public-approved' topic after review.

controls.name: Repository declares an owner
controls.description: The repository has a non-empty 'owner' custom property.
controls.remediation: Define an 'owner' custom property at organization level and set it on the repository.

controls.name: No public projects in the organization
controls.description: All Azure DevOps projects in the organization are private.
controls.remediation: Change public projects to private, or disable public projects in organization policies.

controls.name: Project is private
controls.description: The Azure DevOps project visibility is private.

controls.name: Default branch requires a reviewer
controls.description: A blocking 'Minimum number of reviewers' policy (≥1) protects the default branch.
controls.remediation: Repos → Branches → default branch → Branch policies → Require a minimum number of reviewers.

controls.name: Default branch requires build validation
controls.description: Pull requests into the default branch must pass a build.
controls.remediation: Branch policies → Build validation → add a required pipeline.

controls.name: Authors cannot approve their own pull requests
controls.description: The reviewer policy does not count the PR creator's vote.
controls.remediation: Branch policies → Minimum number of reviewers → untick 'Allow requestors to approve their own changes'.

controls.name: PR comments must be resolved
controls.description: All comments must be resolved before a pull request completes.
controls.remediation: Branch policies → Check for comment resolution → Required.

controls.name: Application has an owner
controls.description: Every application has an accountable owner.
controls.remediation: Set the owner on the application asset.

controls.name: Application has at least two members
controls.description: At least two people are listed against the application.
controls.remediation: Add members to the application asset.

frameworks.name: Ownership & Accountability
